sections.name: Engine Components
sections.intro: CTP® engine parts are designed and manufactured to work hard as an integrated system. We continually improve our techniques to ensure you get quality products with the best technology available in the market. We are committed to lowering your total parts' cost, and maximizing your productivity. The following are some of the CTP Engine parts available:

sections.name: POWER TRAIN
sections.intro: Power train components must hold up high impact loads and frequent changes of direction and movement. CTP® takes under account all these demands using testing procedures that simulate real-world applications. We constantly improve our techniques to ensure our clients receive quality products with the best technology at a competitive edge in a price sensitive market. Our goal is to provide CTP high quality Power train parts that are durable and maximize the productivity of your machine. The following are some of the CTP Power train replacement parts available for your heavy equipment:

sections.name: HYDRAULIC PARTS
sections.intro: The hydraulic system transfers pressure through liquid to drive hydraulic machineries in the lifting of an object. CTP hydraulic parts help increase the force to get the desired power needed to operate your machine. For this reason, machines are constantly relying on their hydraulic system to perform at their optimum and most effective levels. CTP takes into account the importance of this and invest numerous hours into the development and testing of our hydraulic replacement parts. From control valves to the hoses and cylinders, CTP carries a large variety of hydraulic parts for your machine. The following are some of the CTP Hydraulic system replacement parts available for your heavy equipment:

sections.name: Electrical Parts
sections.intro: CTP takes care of every aspect of your machine performance. Tested at our facilities to guarantee their proper working condition, CTP electrical parts are built to last and work in the most extreme environment conditions. The following are some of the CTP Electrical parts available for your heavy equipment:

sections.name: FUEL INJECTION
sections.intro: CTP takes care of every aspect of your machine performance. Tested at our facilities to guarantee their proper working condition, CTP electrical parts are built to last and work in the most extreme environment conditions. The following are some of the CTP Electrical parts available for your heavy equipment:
sections.note: intro text duplicates the Electrical Parts intro verbatim (source-content error)

sections.name: Frame & Body
sections.intro: CTP® uses the latest top of the line technology to improve the wear life and strength of your heavy equipment. CTP® Frame & Body parts are guaranteed to offer extreme protection for your machine even under the most adverse conditions. The following are some of the CTP Frame & Body parts available for your heavy equipment:

sections.name: Undercarriage
sections.intro: Undercarriage components work as a system to move the machine in any type of terrain. CTP® produces high quality undercarriage parts to keep your machine running productively without delays. Undercarriage components can account for a large amount of the repair investment you make over the life of the machine. For this reason, CTP® offers the best high quality undercarriage replacement parts, while giving customers the ability to obtain significant savings to reduce repairs cost on their machine. The following are some of the CTP® undercarriage replacement parts available for your machine:

sections.name: Ground Engaging Tools
sections.intro: Top quality ground engaging tools make a big difference on how well your machine performs. CTP offers top quality ground engaging tools for all earth-moving equipment such as Loaders, Excavators, Backhoe, Dozers, Rippers, Motor Graders, Paving Products and Scrapers. We are proud to offer high quality ground engaging tools with the latest designed shapes for outstanding performance and value in a wide range of applications. Whether you are in the business of construction, excavation, mining, trenching or any other earth-moving enterprise, the value you demand for your money can be found in CTP ground engaging tools. The following are some of the CTP Ground Engaging tools available for your heavy equipment:

sections.name: Hardware
sections.intro: For CTP®, it is imperative to ensure the quality of its products. For this reason we are very selective when it comes to selecting the different materials for the elaboration of our hardware. Many customers rely on CTP® hardware for all their needs because it provides maximum strength, maximum selection and maximum value. CTP meets the following quality standards & norms for our hardware: (DIN) German norms; (SAE) grade 8 and (DIN) 10.9 strength specifications. Our hardware inventory is abundant and stocked with nuts, bolts and screws from the most basics ones, to the most exclusive in the market. The following are some of the categories of CTP hardware parts available:

sections.name: Cooling Systems
sections.intro: The main function of the cooling system is to remove excess heat from the engine. CTP cooling systems components are engineered and tested to make sure the engine on your machine operates at its most efficient temperature at all times. The following are some of the CTP cooling system replacement parts available:

sections.name: CTP Filters
sections.intro: The role of the filters (oil, fuel, air, hydraulic) is to prevent dust, dirt and debris from entering all the critical systems of your machine that cause poor performance and a shorter operating life. For this reason, CTP® filters are engineered to provide maximum protection, increase productivity and ultimately save on the operating cost of your machine. At CTP® we offer a complete range of high quality filtration and separation products to meet your repair needs. The following are some of the CTP® filtration and separator products available for your heavy equipment:

sections.name: Seals and Gaskets
sections.intro: CTP develops, manufactures, and stocks a complete line of seals and gaskets for Caterpillar® equipment assembled into kits at our facilities. Gaskets are produced from Interface® materials that are all environmentally friendly, free of solvents and asbestos. CTP seals and gaskets are made with high technology tools to guarantee an exact dimension and a proper fit, reducing the risk of leakage and increasing their operational life. At CTP you are guaranteed to get high quality gaskets and die cut parts at competitive prices with superior quality. These are some of the seals and gasket products that we offer:

sections.name: Braking
sections.intro: The parts in the braking system work as hard as those in any other system in your machine. CTP® Breaking replacement parts are rigorously inspected to ensure your safety. CTP® offers everything you need for the repair and maintenance of your equipment's braking system. The following are some of the CTP® parts available for your braking system:

sections.name: CTP Rubber Tracks
sections.intro: CTP® rubber tracks are made out of metal core, rubber and steel cord; the finished product forms a continuous type structure. The construction of the rubber track incorporates 3 wound up metal cores, which results in increased bend ability of the track when the crawler is in action. The material and structure of the rubber tracks ultimately provide a low vibration and reduction in noise levels. Reinforced edges are designed with thicker rubber added between the lugs. This reduces the incidence of slicing of the edges resulting in a longer operating cycle.
specialFeatures: 3 Metal Cores Wound Up: Higher durability & Better flexibility
Smaller Contact Surface (Smaller Lug) : Better grip & traction
Reinforced Edges Between Lugs: decreasing the chance of slicing
Jointless: Track is much stronger than the joint type

sections.name: More CTP Products
sections.intro: At CTP® we believe that working on a safer and more comfortable environment makes workdays more productive. For this reason, one of CTP's top priorities is to provide heavy machinery operators the tools and accessories to make their job easier and more productive. From comfortable seats, additives, paints, and chemicals to sizing tools and other products that aid in the workload, CTP® has what you need. The following are some of the CTP® Accessories available for your heavy equipment

products.name: Piston Kits
products.description: Piston Kits come with: Piston, Piston Rings, Retainers, and Piston Pin

products.name: Liner Kits
products.description: Our liner kits come complete with: The piston, pin, liner, gasket kit, rings, retainers, and seals.
products.note: card appears twice in the Engine Components carousel (duplicate within page)

products.name: Remanufactured Blocks
products.description: Short Block: When your cylinder head is in good condition and you are able to refinish it. Long Block: If the Cylinder Head is cracked or out of specks. Medium Block: The medium block is designed for those customers looking for a happy medium. The cylinder head might be damaged yet the oil pump is still in good condition.

products.name: Connecting Rods
products.description: CTP® Connecting Rods are made from steel forgings (malleable or spheroid-graphite iron casting or sinter forgings are beginning to be used for smaller engines).

products.name: Camshafts
products.description: CTP camshafts ensure long-term operation efficiency as a result of careful and quality based production. CTP guarantees low wear and tear camshafts, as well as long-life, smooth running engines.

products.name: Engine Bearings
products.description: CTP® Copper/Lead bearings are made of a sintered trimetal with a base alloy of copper, lead and tin with a nickel dam and Babbitt top layer.

products.name: Stators
products.description: Stators are located at the center of the Torque Converter. They redirect the fluid returning from the turbine before it hits the pump again, increasing the efficiency of the Torque Converter. CTP stocks a wide variety of Stators available to match and repair specific applications.

products.name: Carriers
products.description: CTP carriers are produced from quality cast iron and tempered to remove any stress due to processing.

products.name: Chains
products.description: CTP provides large selection of high quality rugged drive chains and components to increase efficiency and resistance of your machine.

products.name: Joints & Spiders
products.description: CTP high quality universal joints and spider assemblies are available in a complete range of sizes for virtually any type of equipment or application.

products.name: Torque Converter
products.description: Are an essential part of your automatic transmission. They not only allow your vehicle to come to a complete stop without stalling the engine, but also provide more torque when accelerating out of a stop, ultimately, giving you more control over your machine's movements.

products.name: Differential Assembly
products.description: A differential assembly of a machine includes a ring gear, first and second differential side gears and a plurality of pinions configured to mesh with the first and second side gears, and mounted on at least one pinion support pin.

products.name: Transmission
products.description: Is a critical part of a machine's power train. Its function is to take the output from the engine and manipulate it to control speed, direction and torque. Using CTP Powertrain parts can help ensure longer life for your transmission and reduce machine downtime.

products.name: Hydraulic Hoses & Couplings
products.description: CTP offers wide variety of hydraulic hoses and couplings made with best materials and lasts technology to guarantee durability and resistance.

products.name: Hydraulic Cartridges
products.description: CTP Cartridges come in special protective foam to ensure proper handle to its destination. With an improved appearance, CTP Cartridges achieve to reduce the noise levels. Viton® Rings are Included.

products.name: Hydraulic Pumps
products.description: Hydraulic pumps provide oil to all hydraulic motors in the system. CTP Stocks reliable hydraulic pumps that provide excellent performance capabilities in demanding condition.

products.name: Hydraulic Cylinders
products.description: CTP Hydraulic Cylinders are on the job every day, with superior strength and dent resistance reducing costly maintenance and downtime.

products.name: Gear Pump
products.description: With its intermeshing gears that displace fluid they help in the creation of mechanical power. Gear pumps can have external or internal gears.

products.name: Piston Pump
products.description: Hydraulic piston pumps are classified based on the piston position. They are differentiated as axial and radial hydraulic pumps.

products.name: Alternators
products.description: At CTP, all of the alternators go through extensive testing and quality control measures throughout the production process.

products.name: Batteries
products.description: CTP batteries provide plenty of cold cranking power for easy starting and ample reserve power to handle the cycling demands of commercial applications.

products.name: Electrical Terminals
products.description: Corrosion around electrical terminals can lead to loss of current. In order to keep the electrical systems running use non-corrosive CTP Electrical Terminals.

products.name: Glow Plugs
products.description: CTP Glow plugs feature a Tube Alloy that offers a higher resistance to theerosion produced into the combustion chamber. The internal resistance re-design produces a higher durability.

products.name: Gauges
products.description: At CTP® we cover a broad spectrum of gauges for all of your machine's needs. From Electrical Temperature Gauges to Mechanical Pressure Gauges our state-of-the-art technology will allow you to get any needed measurements with accurate results.

products.name: Armatures
products.description: Are electromagnets located inside an electrical motor. Armatures are composed of thin metal plates stacked together forming poles, with thin copper wire coiled around each pole.

products.name: Solenoids
products.description: CTP carries both, starting motor solenoids and fuel shutoff solenoids all built with the quality you come to expect from all CTP parts.

products.name: Injectors
products.description: Our rigorous inspection process ensures CTP injectors have the right fuel delivery, uniformity, injecting angle and atomization to increased fuel efficiency and performance.

products.name: Pencil Nozzle
products.description: Pencil Nozzle is one of the main components of fuel injection systems. It regulates the flow of fuel to the ultimate ignition Compartment. Demand CTP Pencil Nozzles to minimize operation costs.

products.name: Plungers & Barrels
products.description: CTP Plungers & Barrels are optimized parts that will assure you achieve an upgrade on your fuel system as well as the desired engine performance.

products.name: Fuel Assembly Lines
products.description: At CTP we have a complete reference of Fuel Assembly Lines for your convenience. We guarantee a top quality product that will carry fuel, oil and lubricants under low as well as high pressure and high temperature.

products.name: Direct Injection
products.description: The Injector nozzle protrudes directly into the cylinder space through the head and sprays diesel directly into the combustion space. Typically these types of engines require minimal to no glow plugs at start up. They are implemented with electronic fuel injectors and an engine computer telling the injectors when to open and close to allow pressurized fuel to pass into the engine.

products.name: Indirect Injection
products.description: The injector nozzle does not protrude through the head, rather it injects into a separate chamber within the head. The expanding gases spread from the pre-combustion chamber into the cylinder for the firing stroke. Some diesel engines also have pre-combustion nozzles in the pre-combustion chamber.

products.name: Equalizer Bars
products.description: Made with the toughest steel available in the industry, CTP Equalizer Bars are designed and engineered to reduce downtime and prolong the life of the machine.

products.name: Bogie Pins
products.description: We use the highest quality raw materials in all our CTP Bogie Pins to provide longer service life. The centre bushing & core pin are case hardened internally.

products.name: Frames
products.description: CTP Frames are built to absorb high impact shock loads and twisting forces on the machine even in the harshest environments. It is made with high quality steel castings to increase the strength of the main case.

products.name: Bogies
products.description: CTP bogies are designed to offer top class quality suspension, stability, and safety by absorbing vibration and minimizing centrifugal forces.

products.name: Idlers
products.description: CTP offers idlers that are made of premium quality cast steel. Using state of the art technology, idlers undergo a special heat treatment that provides them with long durability and smoothness.

products.name: Track links
products.description: CTP Track Links have excellent wear resistance, even in the most severe working conditions. This is assured by modern rail induction hardening systems. This process offers the necessary control and accuracy to focus the heat to a specific area of the part.

products.name: Track adjuster & recoil
products.description: CTP Track adjuster & recoil ensure optimum shock absorbance, protects your machine from grease leakage and reduces the risk of compressing and releasing the spring.

products.name: Rollers
products.description: All CTP Rollers are produced with cutting edge processes such as rotator friction welding robots or induction heat treatments to ensure proper hardness levels. They are highly praised in the market as a product with a long wear life, and impact resistance.

products.name: Sprockets & Rims
products.description: CTP sprockets provide a high resistance and durability even under the toughest circumstances. They are of extraordinary quality due to the perfect combination of high quality cast steel and an advanced heat treatment technology.

products.name: Track Shoes
products.description: CTP track shoes are heat treated to provide a higher tensile strength to resist bending and breaking in high impact conditions. We stock a variety of track shoes options to meet the requirements of your work environment.

products.name: Self-Sharpening Teeth
products.description: CTP Self-sharpening teeth come with more penetrating capabilities. Cut Down replacement costs by keeping a sharp point throughout the tooth's life.

products.name: End Bits
products.description: CTP End Bits provide superior strength, longer wear life and increased the productivity of the machine. They are designed to move more material over a longer period with less downtime.

products.name: Dozer blades
products.description: CTP Dozer blades are designed and manufactured from a boron steel to ensure productivity and provide the best performance in your machine even in the harshest dozing environments.

products.name: Pins & Retainers
products.description: CTP Pins and retainers are made with the toughest materials in the market. To improve on the longevity and prevent corrosion, our pins and retainers are zinc plated.

products.name: Motor Grader Blades
products.description: CTP® Grader blades are manufactured from Boron Steel Alloy and heat treated and tempered to needed specifications to ensure the best combination of wear and impact resistance.

products.name: Tips and Adapters
products.description: CTP® Tips and Adapters are designed to maximize wear life and efficiency.

products.name: Ripper Teeth
products.description: Ripper teeth are used in very hostile environments, making it necessary to purchase a quality brand. CTP Branded ripper teeth provide rapid penetration and aggressive ripping angle, along with increased impact resistance. There are several styles of ripper teeth. The Centerline teeth are used in conditions where penetration is not a problem and Penetration teeth are used in conditions where penetration is difficult.

products.name: Woodruff Keys
products.description: CTP offers a wide range of Woodruff Keys that are manufactured using medium carbon steel and machined for a smooth finish.

products.name: Rivets
products.description: CTP Rivets are available in Flat Head, Button Head and Blind. Different standards and surface finishes are also available.

products.name: Cotter Pins
products.description: We Stock all type of cotter pins: stainless steel cotter pins, zinc plated steel cotter pins, copper cotter pins, and aluminum cotter pins.

products.name: Self-Locking Nuts
products.description: CTP Self-Locking Nuts (All Metal & Nylon Insert) are made of fine grain steel. They are ideal in applications where vibration or motion could loosen or undo the nut.

products.name: Plow Bolts
products.description: Has a domed head that puts extra metal at the wearing surface. They are used primarily in grader and bulldozer blades to prolong use before the bolt needs to be replaced. Plow bolts have a countersunk square neck.

products.name: Self-Locking Nylon Patch
products.description: CTP self-locking nylon patch formula is specially designed as non-ozone depleting locking and sealing coating for threaded fasteners. It ultimately prevents fasteners from loosing, even under extreme vibration.

products.name: Radiator Cores
products.description: CTP designs its folded core radiators to resist vibration and stress damage, increasing reliability and life in your application.

products.name: Fans
products.description: All CTP fans are perfectly balanced to run more efficiently. As a result, the engine is kept cooler prolonging its life. Reversible blades fans are also available.

products.name: Water Pumps
products.description: At CTP we offer you a broad selection of water pumps that ensure the excellent performance of your machine's cooling system.

products.name: Oil Coolers
products.description: Cool and maintain your engine with top quality CTP Oil Coolers. They are pressure tested in our facilities to ensure leak-proof quality.

products.name: Liquid Cooling
products.description: The cooling system circulates fluid through piping and engine passageways to extract heat from the engine block. The hot liquid passes through the radiator and cools down as it comes into contact with the radiator walls. The radiator exchanges this heat with the atmosphere and cool liquid re-circulates to the engine passageways again.

products.name: Air Cooling
products.description: Instead of circulating fluid through the engine, the engine block is covered in aluminum fins that conduct the heat away from the cylinder. A powerful fan forces air over these fins, which cools the engine by transferring the heat to the air.

products.name: Air Filters
products.description: The open and closed end caps of the CTP Air Filters are fabricated using a polyurethane material that is highly elastic and Provides a high resistance to vibration and impact.

products.name: Strainers
products.description: Lower your operating costs by maintaining your system running clean of debris with high quality CTP Strainers.

products.name: Fuel & Oil Filters
products.description: For a much cleaner running engine lubrication system and contamination control performance use quality CTP Fuel & Oil filters.

products.name: Filter service Indicators
products.description: Filter service based on restriction readings can enable you to obtain the longest life possible from the filter, and the best engine protection. CTP offers a variety of devices that help you get maximum filter utilization.

products.name: ABC Gasket Kits
products.description: Designed to consolidate gasket kits and make it easier for the rebuilder himself to quickly identify and organize the seals and gaskets. Check out our Online ABC KITS Catalog

products.name: Multi-Purpose O-Ring Kits
products.description: O-Ring Kit contains Nitrile 75 Hardness, substantially improving the lifetime of the machine and the component. It can be used in any industrial application from automotive to heavy equipment.

products.name: Hydraulic Seal Kits
products.description: O-Ring Kits contain Nitrile 75 Hardness, substantially improving the lifetime of the machine and the components. They come in a special black suitcase style with interior foam and can be used in any industrial application from automotive to heavy equipment.

products.name: Repair kits
products.description: CTP has a complete range of repair kits and components parts for all your repair needs; from the water pump, transmission and turbocharger to all the engine structures.

products.name: Crankshaft Seals
products.description: Front and rear crankshaft seals have wear sleeves to provide increased crank reusability. Wear sleeve improves performance of the seal, keeping the dirt away from the sealing lips; this avoids the contamination of oil, maintaining its lubrication properties. The seal has grooves in the seal lip that return to the oil to the deposit during the rotation of the crankshaft.

products.name: Beaded Gasket
products.description: The Nitrile or Silicone Beaded Gasket technology provides better sealability of the gasket in places where your application needs it the most to prevent any potential leak paths.

products.name: Actuators
products.description: CTP Actuators are specifically designed to perform even in the harshest braking environments. Master cylinder pushrod is covered by a rubber boot for additional dirt and moisture protection.

products.name: Braking Pads
products.description: CTP Sintered Metal Brake pads Increase density for longer life. Also, offer a High friction resistant with quiet performance.

products.name: Braking Cables
products.description: Most parking brakes use cables to connect the control lever or pedal to the service brakes. CTP Braking system cables are made of high-strength strands of steel wire that are tightly twisted together.

products.name: Friction Discs
products.description: CTP only provides Friction Discs that are made with 100% Asbesto-Free material to ensure the top quality you deserve.

products.name: Hydraulic Brake System
products.description: Works on the principle that pressure on the brake fluid is applied evenly throughout a closed system. When the brake pedal is pressed, a piston in the master cylinder moves the brake fluid through steel lines applying equal force to all the wheels. The pressure of the brake fluid causes the pistons in the wheel cylinders to be forced outward pressing the linings against the discs or drums.

products.name: Air Brake System
products.description: Uses a compressor driven by the engine to fill pressurized tanks with air. When the brake pedal is pressed, a valve allows a certain amount of air pressure to the brake chambers at each wheel. The harder the brake pedal is pressed, the more pressure you give to the brake chambers.There are three different air braking systems: service brake, parking brake, and emergency brake.

products.name: Inhibitor
products.description: CTP inhibitor is a product designed to change the sulfate and nitrate levels effectively. It is composed of corrosion inhibitors and lubricants that protect and promote the lifespan of the cooling system components.

products.name: Grease Gun
products.description: This portable lubricator comes along with three hoses and a kit with a variety of the most popular and used fittings.

specifications.includes: three hoses and a fittings kit

products.name: CTP Seats
products.description: CTP Seats now include more features and accessories to enhance the operator's comfort. Check out all the available CTP seats in your CTP Store.

products.name: Hand Cleaner Towels
products.description: CTP Hand Cleaner Towels have a citrus-based formula combined with a tough, textured orange towel to loosen, dissolve and absorb dirt and grease leaving your hands truly clean without the need of water or others products.

products.name: CTP Power Diesel
products.description: Water is welcome almost everywhere except in your diesel fuel engine. Water in diesel fuel severely damages injectors, corrodes tanks and fosters the growth of bacteria. Our highly concentrated CTP Diesel Power™ totally disperses water for a complete combustion and is also an all in one package which cleans the injection system and contains lubricity additives. Increase your engine's performance by giving CTP Diesel Power™ a place in your engine today.

products.name: Cabin Glasses
products.description: Protect yourself from the dusty conditions of the outside with high quality CTP Cabin Glasses. We stock the most popular cabin glasses for motor graders, wheel loaders and excavators.
